Empty key bypasses injection validation\n}\n```\n\n## Patches Applied\n\n### Patch 1: 0001-add-javascript-config-validation.patch\n**File**: and applied:\n\n1. **Reject unknown JSON properties** via `@JsonAnySetter` handlers\n2. **Validate injected dependencies** are not null\n3. **Fail fast** at object construction time, not execution
